literal_meaning: মৃত্যু বা ধ্বংসের প্রতীক (death or destruction symbol)
figurative_meaning_en: Cause of total destruction or doom
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাকে সমর্থন করার ফলে আমার কাল হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Supporting him led to my doom.
That decision was the cause of his total ruin.
note: The term 'কাল' draws from ancient Bengali concepts of time and fate, often implying inevitable ruin.
